Epic-level AC -> child evidence map (all 9 children closed, evidence per-child comment):
1. Corpus AC -> celestine-treasonous-ewe (471c): manifest row_count 6401, verified_ratio 0.1339 broken out per generation, deterministic rebuild, zero LLM.
2. Labels/noise-floor AC -> expectable-clownlike-ynambu (4bd8): 75/75 mutation-verified unit tests + real 40-ticket subset run, keyed to corpus content_hash, zero LLM.
3. Tier-0/Pass-3 AC -> bouncy-peacockish-titmouse (5d19): full-corpus replay (3758 reviews/35082 findings), plan-v4/v5 rescore reproduction, label-proxy metrics, <5min runtime, zero LLM.
4. Tier-1/Pass-2 AC -> presolar-finable-binturong (53ab): 60/60 stratified sample, per-question agreement noise floor, ledger-priced Bedrock Sonnet run ($6.72), cache-write>0.
5. Tier-2/Pass-1 AC -> peaceable-choppy-sapsucker (f1d6): fixed stratified sample, norm_id/criterion finding-set comparison, single-criterion mode; harness repo_root fix landed (Gerrit 2450).
6. Ledger AC -> fizzy-hypnotic-boto (4c80): reserve/finalize/reconcile refusal + idempotency, 13/13 unit tests, held-out TDD.
7. Model-parity/Bedrock AC -> magnesian-subjective-ocelot (efd4): resolve_pinned_model + refuse_diff_on_model_mismatch + non-Bedrock refusal, 19/19 tests.
8. Prompt-caching AC -> efd4 (check_cache_effective) + ledger.jsonl direct evidence: tier2-current-1a3b33234da9 row shows cache_read_tokens=81401>0 on a repeat run.
9. Protocol ADR/docs AC -> furred-uneasy-platypus (7a95): ADR 0109 (Gerrit 2475, merged e831291dd94c) + docs/plan-review-gate.md tier-selection/noise-band section + passing-code-review.md pointer.

Total ledger spend at close: see docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/replay/ledger.jsonl (well under the $200 cap across tier1/tier2 commissioning rows). All boxes checked against this evidence.
